rust.name: src/paragraph.rs:470:26: replace || with && in decision

rust.name: src/paragraph.rs:580:41: replace >= with < in named

rust.name: src/paragraph.rs:210:15: replace > with < in item

rust.name: src/paragraph.rs:342:26: replace && with || in quoted
